sources.summary: Equinix Hong Kong director Ka Wing Tang describes HK6’s cooling in an emailed response: controls respond to temperature and computing demand, hot exhaust is separated from cooled air, and the facility supports direct-to-chip liquid cooling.
sources.date_semantics: Original article datePublished and visible time element both give 7 September 2026. Modified 8 September. The observation uses the publication date of the current facility-specific participant account; no exact interview day or opening day is inferred.

firsthand_status_statement.speaker: Ka Wing Tang
firsthand_status_statement.statement: The named operator director describes HK6 currently adjusting cooling automatically to temperature and computing demand, segregating exhaust and cooled air, and supporting direct-to-chip liquid cooling in an emailed reply.
firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: Publication day of the current operator account; exact interview day is unspecified.
firsthand_status_statement.review: Read original article and checked structured and visible publication metadata. The account describes the named facility’s current operating systems, corroborated by the historical 16 June operator opening. Regional power statistics and other operators are excluded.

sources.title: HK6 — Hong Kong data centre specifications
sources.summary: HK6 is at 18 Sha Tsui Road, Tsuen Wan. Equinix lists 3,865 m² (41,600 sq ft) of colocation space and N+1 redundancy for UPS, generators and cooling. Direct-to-chip liquid cooling is supported.
sources.date_semantics: Undated current facility page, used for identity and specifications, not to refresh the dated operating observation.

sources.title: Equinix launches AI-ready data center with direct connectivity to Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park
sources.summary: Equinix officially opened HK6 on 16 June 2026 with an initial investment of US$124 million. The operator forecasts 3,550 cabinets at full build-out; this is future capacity. Its Tsuen Wan campus network connects HK6 with separately located HK1, HK2 and HK3.
sources.date_semantics: Historical official opening outside the 90-day admission window; context only. Current operation is supported by the separate 7 September participant account.
sources.capacity_discrepancy: This release reports 1,000 Phase 1 cabinets. A 3 July operator employee interview reports 900 across six halls. No reconciled current Phase 1 cabinet count is asserted in the Atlas.

sources.title: Equinix Opens Innovation Centers Globally to Accelerate Enterprise Infrastructure Deployments
sources.summary: Equinix launched its EPIC liquid-cooling programme in several cities, including Osaka OS3. Each location operates inside a live Equinix data centre and provides a working environment for customers to evaluate infrastructure.
sources.date_semantics: The article heading, body dateline and URL all identify 21 October 2026. This is a report of existing operation, not OS3’s original opening date. EPIC is the new hosted programme; the underlying data centre already existed.

sources.title: Equinix Japan: global EPIC launch names Osaka OS3
sources.summary: Equinix’s Japanese announcement names Osaka OS3 among the locations already offering the EPIC liquid-cooling service within an operating data centre.
sources.date_semantics: Body dateline says 22 October 2026, whereas the page header says 21 October. The body observation is 22 October; publication date is left unresolved. The consistent 21 October global release supplies the selected status date.

sources.title: Equinix Osaka OS3 official facility page and embedded map
sources.summary: OS3 occupies the Keihanshin OBP Building at 2-2-82 Shiromi, Chuo-ku, Osaka. Equinix lists 7,467 m² of colocation space, seismic isolation, N+1 UPS and generators, at least 48 hours of generator autonomy at full load, and N+20% cooling redundancy. It supports direct-to-chip liquid cooling, colocation, Equinix Fabric and interconnection services.
sources.date_semantics: Live product page has no verified publication or specification observation date. Capture date does not refresh status. Building height/storey count is omitted because the operator’s 14-storey description differs from the landlord’s 16-storey parent-building description.

sources.title: Equinix Opens a New Data Center in Osaka
sources.summary: Equinix announced the opening of OS3’s first phase on 20 October 2021. It connects with the separately located OS1 facility. The historical announcement’s later-phase cabinet targets are not a current capacity measurement.
sources.date_semantics: Historical opening announcement, outside the 90-day freshness window. Only the October 2026 release supports current admission freshness.

sources.title: CSCEC reports current data-centre construction in Ulanqab
sources.summary: CSCEC reports continuing electrical, plumbing and HVAC work under its combined Huawei Phase 3 DC5 / Phase 4 DC4 contract, delivered by its Fourth Engineering Bureau. In a separate section, it reports that VNET’s zero-carbon campus Phase 1 A2 mechanical and electrical project has entered final acceptance, with the Eighth Engineering Bureau as contractor. Completed acceptance and operation are not confirmed for A2.
sources.date_semantics: Publication date confirms current work described by the contractor. Exact inspection or milestone day is unstated; it is not an opening or completion date.

scope_quotations.purpose: Exact combined-contract name; establishes that DC5 belongs to Phase 3, while DC4 belongs to Phase 4.
scope_quotations.literal: 乌兰察布华为云数据中心三期DC5、四期DC4及附属设施机电工程项目

scope_quotations.purpose: Current-tense physical work; applies to the combined contract and is not a DC5-only quantity.
scope_quotations.literal: 正在重点实施高压及低压电气工程、给排水工程、暖通工程

scope_quotations.purpose: Named primary participant, retained separately from the narrator.

sources.interpretation_limit: The contractor names both components and describes current construction collectively. It does not provide a separate DC5-only work quantity, capacity, completion percentage or opening date. Only the Phase 3 DC5 fit-out component is selected; Phase 4 DC4 remains excluded.
